blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A total of 4,850 land titles are set to be distributed to farmers in Negros Oriental, the Department of Agrarian Reform (DAR) said Wednesday. READ: DAR: Decades-long farm lot distribution program may be completed in 2027 In a statement, the DAR said land titles will be distributed on Nov. 26 as the government advances its agrarian reform program, pairing secure land ownership with debt relief The distribution will be held in Dumaguete City, along with a trade exhibit giving agrarian reform beneficiary organizations an opportunity to showcase and market their products.
